title: Too Good For The Casino
why_movie: A real first-person Kevin story with a place, people and a twist: the casino, the two big men, the owner eating spaghetti.
keep: Let me tell you an interesting story about cards
I met a guy named Bobby Singer
I just remembered all the cards
I proceeded to play for about an hour
you need to come with us
I'm thinking, Okay, I've seen this
I've seen this in the movies
The owner and the president wants to meet you
because you're just too good for us

payoff: because you're just too good for us
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says he sat down at a single-deck blackjack table in Reno, one on one with the dealer, and remembered every card. About an hour later, he says, he had made $250,000.

Then two very large men tapped him on the shoulder.

He expected the back room. They walked him to the restaurant instead, where the owner sat eating a plate of spaghetti. What the owner told him is the part nobody guesses.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching how to use your mind to get what you want in life. They were recorded live at a private event in the Alps.

Most people will watch this and scroll on. A few will comment "WISH" and start listening tonight.
